run_alphadev_algorithm: run the AlphaDev algorithm with a given config to train a network via self-play and MCTS
create_alphadev_config: create an AlphaDevConfig with MCTS hyperparameters, network architecture settings, and task specification
play_alphadev_game: play a single AlphaDev game using MCTS and a network to generate assembly program data
run_mcts_search: run Monte Carlo Tree Search with UCB scoring to select actions in the AlphaDev environment
train_alphadev_network: train the AlphaDev representation and prediction network on replay buffer samples with SGD
